question: Pongal is a festival of which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pongal:-**

 
 
• **It is a harvest festival celebrated in the southern Indian state of Tamil Nadu.**
 
• The festival is dedicated to the Sun God and is celebrated as a thanksgiving for a bountiful harvest.
 
• Pongal is a four-day festival and is celebrated in the month of Thai (January-February
